name: Isle 🏝️
desc:
Brought here against your will. 
No one has ever escaped alive. 
... 
Something's lurking. 
There has to be some way out. 

For the best experience, play with friends, and avoid using external guides, tutorials or wikis. 

Go in blind. Explore, collect journals, learn from each death, and find a way off the island.
